join_order.notes: Driver. Filter cc rows where subject_id in cct1_ids AND status_id == cct2_id. Skip nullable movie_id (INT32_MIN). Yields ~25-30% of cc rows ~= 30-40K candidate movie_ids. Deduplicate via flat_hash_set<int32> mv_set.
Per mv, check production_year[mv-1] > 2000 (and != INT32_MIN). ~30% pass.

join_order.probe: movie_keyword via offsets_only index per mv
join_order.notes: For each surviving mv, scan mk rows in [mk_off[mv], mk_off[mv+1]); keep mv if any keyword_id in k_ids. Use direct membership test on k_ids (tiny flat_hash_set).

join_order.probe: movie_info via offsets_only index per mv
join_order.notes: For each surviving mv, scan mi rows in [mi_off[mv], mi_off[mv+1]); for rows with info_type_id==it1_id AND info length in [5,8] AND info equals 'Horror' or 'Thriller', capture mi.info slice for MIN aggregation.

join_order.probe: movie_info_idx via offsets_only index per mv
join_order.notes: For each surviving mv, scan mi_idx rows; for rows with info_type_id==it2_id, capture mi_idx.info slice for MIN aggregation.

join_order.probe: cast_info via offsets_only index per mv
join_order.notes: For each surviving mv, scan ci rows in [ci_off[mv], ci_off[mv+1]); for rows where note in writer_note_set, fetch pid=person_id, test name.gender[pid-1]==m_code, then capture name.name slice (row pid-1) for MIN.

filters.predicate: subject_id IN cct1_ids AND status_id == cct2_id

data_structures.mi_info_set: small inline string match (length 5-8 prefilter + equality)
data_structures.aggregation: 4 scalar string_view mins (mi.info, mi_idx.info, name.name, title.title) + 4 booleans 'have_value'

parallelism.partition: Partition mv_candidates across threads after dedup; each thread maintains thread-local 4-min struct; reduce at end.
parallelism.notes: Dim resolution and complete_cast driver scan are cheap and can run single-threaded. The per-mv probe loop over surviving candidates parallelizes across threads.

indexes.purpose: offsets_only (not used for driver; driver is linear scan of cc)

aggregation: scalar_global_min (4 string_view minima with first-set flags; lexicographic compare on raw bytes)
